# skycloak_siem_destination (Resource)

A SIEM forwarding destination for the workspace (syslog, S3, or HTTP). SIEM forwarding is plan-gated; the API rejects the calls on plans without it. Secret fields are write-only: the API never returns them, reads report `has_*` booleans instead, and Terraform keeps the configured values in state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Forward security logs to a syslog collector over TLS.
resource "skycloak_siem_destination" "syslog" {
  name = "corporate-siem"
  type = "syslog"

  source = {
    type = "security_logs"
  }

  syslog = {
    host     = "siem.example.com"
    port     = 6514
    protocol = "tls"
    format   = "rfc5424"
  }
}

# Forward Keycloak login events to an HTTP collector (e.g. Splunk HEC).
resource "skycloak_siem_destination" "splunk" {
  name = "splunk-hec"
  type = "http"

  source = {
    type                 = "keycloak_events"
    keycloak_event_types = ["LOGIN", "LOGIN_ERROR", "LOGOUT"]
  }

  http = {
    url          = "https://hec.example.com/services/collector"
    auth_type    = "bearer"
    bearer_token = var.splunk_hec_token # write-only; never read back
  }

  batch = {
    max_events           = 500
    max_interval_seconds = 30
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Destination name.
- `source` (Attributes) Which workspace data stream is forwarded. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source))
- `type` (String) Destination type: `syslog`, `s3`, or `http`. Immutable.

### Optional

- `batch` (Attributes) Batching tuning. Defaults to the API contract values (1000 events, 60 seconds) so an omitted block plans exactly what the server applies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--batch))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether forwarding is active. Defaults to `true`.
- `http` (Attributes) HTTP destination config (when `type` is `http`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--http))
- `s3` (Attributes) S3 destination config (when `type` is `s3`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--s3))
- `syslog` (Attributes) Syslog destination config (when `type` is `syslog`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--syslog))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `failure_count` (Number) Consecutive delivery failures.
- `health_status` (String) `healthy`, `degraded`, or `failed`.
- `id` (String) Destination ID (UUID).
- `last_error` (String) Most recent delivery error.
- `last_sent_at` (String) Last successful delivery.
- `total_bytes_sent` (Number)
- `total_events_sent` (Number)
- `total_logs_sent` (Number)
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source`

Required:

- `type` (String) Stream: `application_logs`, `keycloak_events`, `security_logs`, or `skycloak_audit`.

Optional:

- `cluster_ids` (List of String) Cluster IDs to include. Omit for all clusters.
- `keycloak_event_types` (List of String) Keycloak event type codes. Required when `type` is `keycloak_events`.
- `realms` (List of String) Realm names to include. Omit for all realms.


<a id="nestedatt--batch"></a>
### Nested Schema for `batch`

Optional:

- `max_events` (Number) Flush after this many events. Defaults to `1000`.
- `max_interval_seconds` (Number) Flush at least this often. Defaults to `60`.


<a id="nestedatt--http"></a>
### Nested Schema for `http`

Required:

- `auth_type` (String) `basic`, `bearer`, or `none`.
- `url` (String) Collector endpoint URL.

Optional:

- `bearer_token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token (when `auth_type` is `bearer`). Write-only.
- `headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Extra HTTP headers. Values are write-only; reads return header names only.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password (when `auth_type` is `basic`). Write-only.
- `username` (String) Username (when `auth_type` is `basic`).

Read-Only:

- `has_auth_credentials` (Boolean) Whether auth credentials are stored.


<a id="nestedatt--s3"></a>
### Nested Schema for `s3`

Required:

- `auth_type` (String) `access_key`, `assume_role`, `iam_role`, or `irsa`.
- `bucket` (String) Bucket name.
- `region` (String) Bucket region.

Optional:

- `access_key_id` (String, Sensitive) Access key ID (when `auth_type` is `access_key`). Write-only.
- `external_id` (String) External ID for role assumption.
- `prefix` (String) Object key prefix.
- `role_arn` (String) Role ARN (when `auth_type` is `assume_role`).
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) Secret access key (when `auth_type` is `access_key`). Write-only.

Read-Only:

- `has_access_key_secret` (Boolean) Whether a secret access key is stored.


<a id="nestedatt--syslog"></a>
### Nested Schema for `syslog`

Required:

- `format` (String) `rfc5424`, `cef`, `leef`, or `json`.
- `host` (String) Syslog server hostname or IP.
- `port` (Number) Syslog server port.
- `protocol` (String) `tcp`, `tls`, or `udp`.
